scope: admin one-click publish feedback and installed-user update reminder hotfix
rootCause: Admin release_state treated any version different from current as promotable, so older staged releases could appear as publishable after a hotfix version was current.
The admin release page disabled non-promotable publish buttons, which made user clicks produce no visible feedback.
The Web client only showed background-update-installed prompts and did not proactively poll the stable public update-check endpoint for installable WebUI updates.
fixes: AdminStore now compares release versions, blocks downgrade candidates, and exposes promoteDisabledReason for every staged release.
The admin release page keeps the publish button clickable for non-promotable candidates and surfaces the disabled reason through a warning notice.
The Web client polls /api/update-check with the detected platform, shows a dismissible update banner, and opens the download page from the prompt.
notes: Unauthenticated /api/update-check returns 401; the reminder is exercised by logged-in clients that carry the normal app session cookie.

Already-open old browser tabs cannot execute the new polling code until they reload, but installed clients on older artifacts can discover this 0.2.7.1 hotfix through the same public update-check contract after loading the updated client.
